title: 48-Hour Listing Face-Lift Planner
oneLiner: A pre-sale home styling planner that helps agents and homeowners choose the cheapest visual fixes that most improve listing photos, curb appeal, and first-showing confidence.
targetUser: Residential real estate agents, stagers, and homeowners preparing a home for listing within one week.
keyUX: Walk room by room, score visual distractions, and turn them into a prioritized two-day makeover plan with budget, impact, and photo-order guidance.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop listing-prep planner called 48-Hour Listing Face-Lift Planner for real estate agents, stagers, and homeowners preparing a property for sale. It should help them decide which low-cost visual changes will most improve listing photos, curb appeal, and buyer first impressions before the photographer arrives. Include listing impact summary cards, a room-by-room photo audit board, a curb appeal checklist, a budget versus visual upside matrix, a two-day prep timeline, and a before-shoot shot list drawer. Design direction: use a premium-editorial aesthetic with warm stone surfaces, refined typography, restrained luxury spacing, and polished photo-forward composition so the product feels aspirational, calm, and sale-smart without becoming flashy.
